name: Review title
on: pull_request
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Print title
        shell: bash
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
